review_notes: Installed Flake8 entry points E/W are attributed to their real pycodestyle provider, F to pyflakes, and other reporters/extensions to their original distribution. Mechanism is provider dispatch during plugin discovery; distinct production function and contract from duplicate distribution handling. Not an independent example solely because task IDs differ. Source Smith patch is bug-introducing; reviewer compared exact upstream function. Full original test-file union and F2P/P2P are unchanged. No model inference or causal preference pair is claimed.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
from flake8.plugins import finder
actual=Path(finder.__file__).resolve()
expected=(Path.cwd()/'src/flake8/plugins/finder.py').resolve()
assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
print('source_binding',actual,'sha256',hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
import importlib.metadata as metadata
dist=metadata.distribution('flake8')
plugins=list(finder._flake8_plugins(dist.entry_points,dist.metadata['Name'],dist.version))
observed={p.entry_point.name:p.package for p in plugins}
print('actual_entrypoint_package_attribution',observed)
assert observed['F']=='pyflakes',observed
assert observed['E']=='pycodestyle',observed
assert observed['W']=='pycodestyle',observed
assert observed['default']=='flake8',observed
PYREPLAY
